name: models
license_scope: The repository root LICENSE explicitly applies Apache-2.0 to all files under /research; copied files that carry upstream headers retain them, while the repository-level license governs files without a local header.

model_weights.name: YAMNet Keras HDF5 weights
model_weights.notes: The upstream YAMNet README links this binary but does not state a license for it. The repository Apache-2.0 code license is not assumed to cover this separately hosted artifact. Not copied.

model_weights.name: YAMNet TensorFlow Hub SavedModel variables
model_weights.notes: The downloadable archive contains SavedModel variables and a class map but no LICENSE or NOTICE artifact establishing a weight license. Not copied.

useful_files.purpose: Records YAMNet's detector contract, preprocessing dimensions, model size, class vocabulary, and export prerequisites.
useful_files.audioShield_target: Future detector implementation notes; do not copy into production as runtime code.

useful_files.purpose: Keras model definition producing per-patch class scores and 1024-dimensional embeddings.
useful_files.audioShield_target: Future detector adapter or offline conversion tooling; TensorFlow/Keras dependency must be removed or isolated for browser use.

useful_files.purpose: Defines waveform padding, STFT, mel projection, stabilized log features, and a TFLite-compatible STFT path.
useful_files.audioShield_target: Future browser detector preprocessing adapter; reimplement or validate numerically in JavaScript/WebAudio-compatible code.

useful_files.purpose: Authoritative detector constants: 16 kHz input, 25 ms window, 10 ms hop, 64 mel bands, 0.96 s patches, and 0.48 s patch hop.
useful_files.audioShield_target: Future detector adapter specification; Python dataclass itself is not browser runtime code.

useful_files.purpose: Reference inference flow for float normalization, stereo-to-mono conversion, resampling, per-frame scores, and top-class aggregation.
useful_files.audioShield_target: Future detector adapter contract and offline validation harness; soundfile/resampy/TensorFlow must not be shipped to the extension.

useful_files.purpose: Reference TF2, TFLite, and TFJS export pipeline with a waveform input signature and class-map asset.
useful_files.audioShield_target: Offline model conversion tooling; do not run as part of MV3 playback. Export output still requires independent weight licensing and browser smoke tests.

useful_files.purpose: Maps all 521 output indices to AudioSet MIDs and display names used by detector rules.
useful_files.audioShield_target: Future detector class mapping; preserve index order and attribution.

useful_files.purpose: Upstream sanity checks for silence, white noise, and sine wave predictions.
useful_files.audioShield_target: Future offline detector regression fixture; requires a licensed weight artifact and a browser-side parity test before use.
